title: Tia | After a brief connection loss, the panel says "Tia is already answering you in another tab or app"
summary: When the connection drops for a few seconds while Tia is thinking, the panel blames another tab instead of the lost connection.
steps: Open CRM, open Tia and send: How many leads, contacts, deals and accounts are there? Give each number.
While the panel shows "Thinking…", lose the connection for a few seconds (for example switch Wi-Fi off and on).
Look at the panel, then press Try again.
expected: The panel says the connection was lost and either keeps waiting for the same answer or offers Try again.
actual: The panel shows "Tia is already answering you in another tab or app. Try again when it's done." with a Try again button, although only one tab was open. After the connection is back, Try again gives the right answer, and the chat history has one question and one answer (no duplicate).
more: Tested by cutting every connection of the browser through a local proxy while Tia was thinking.
Sending a message while already offline shows the right message: "Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again."
